default.$description:
Req for: elements that stay in view from the start to the end of the transition, such as a toggle
Use: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.3, 0.95)

enter.$description:
Req for: elements entering the screen: a quick start that slows to a rest
Use: cubic-bezier(0.4, 1, 0.89, 1)

exit.$description:
Req for: elements leaving the screen: a slow start that speeds out of the way
Use: cubic-bezier(0.11, 0, 0.6, 0)

linear.$description:
Req for: changes of opacity and color; never movement
Use: cubic-bezier(0, 0, 1, 1)

050.$description:
Req for: pressed states and other immediate feedback
Use: 50 ms

080.$description:
Req for: micro-interactions, hover states and fades
Use: 80 ms

200.$description:
Req for: short movements and small expansions
Use: 200 ms

300.$description:
Req for: short movements and expansions, such as an accordion
Use: 300 ms

400.$description:
Req for: long movements and large expansions
Use: 400 ms

600.$description:
Req for: the longest movements and expansions
Use: 600 ms

default.$description:
Req for: most micro-interactions that involve movement, such as a toggle
Use: motion/easing/default over motion/duration/080, with no delay

default-opacity.$description:
Req for: micro-interactions on opacity or color, such as the hover state of a button or a chip
Use: motion/easing/linear over motion/duration/080, with no delay

default-fast.$description:
Req for: immediate feedback, such as a pressed state
Use: motion/easing/linear over motion/duration/050, with no delay

open.$description:
Req for: elements that open into view, such as a dropdown menu
Use: motion/easing/enter over motion/duration/200, with no delay

dismiss.$description:
Req for: elements dismissed by the user or automatically
Use: motion/easing/linear over motion/duration/080, with no delay

slide-in.$description:
Req for: elements that slide into view from the bottom, such as a toast
Use: motion/easing/enter over motion/duration/300, with no delay

slide-out.$description:
Req for: elements that slide out of view
Use: motion/easing/default over motion/duration/200, with no delay
